_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.110

Trial summaries and results.csv now include measured-rate decisions, startup
valve changes, rate-error RMS in mmHg/s and ramp-error RMS in mmHg. Live plots
hide inactive position-PID terms when firmware reports measured-rate control.
Original raw events and timestamps remain intact. No firmware/controller or
calibration change; experimental controller work is not included.
